query: Which material can be used for lightweight and superior comprehensive performance, and why?

generation.hypothesis: Aluminum-Lithium (Al-Li) alloy with optimized composition can achieve a 20% reduction in weight while maintaining superior comprehensive performance compared to traditional aluminum alloys.
generation.material_initial_state: Aluminum alloy in solid solution state
generation.intervention: Alloy composition optimization by adding Lithium (Li) and adjusting the ratio of other alloying elements
generation.conditions: General operating conditions, including temperature range of -20°C to 100°C and stress levels up to 300 MPa
generation.mechanism: The addition of Li reduces the density of the alloy while maintaining its strength, and the optimized composition enhances the precipitation hardening effect, leading to improved comprehensive performance
generation.predicted_outcome: 20% reduction in weight and 15% increase in strength-to-weight ratio compared to traditional aluminum alloys
generation.boundary: Alloy composition: 2-4 wt% Li, 1-2 wt% Cu, 1-2 wt% Mg
generation.uncertainty: The actual performance of the optimized Al-Li alloy may vary depending on the specific processing conditions and microstructure

falsification_experiment.design: Tensile testing and density measurement of optimized Al-Li alloy samples
falsification_experiment.falsification_rule: If the measured strength-to-weight ratio of the optimized Al-Li alloy is less than 10% higher than that of the traditional aluminum alloy, the hypothesis is falsified
